Name: Bleed
Effect: Take 1 damage per tile moved; each point of damage removes a stack.
Sources: Cerberus 'Second Head' bite below 66% HP (5); Cerberus 'Swipe' (8); Large Bear 'Maul' (4; 8 when enraged below 50% HP, and the bear heals from the bleed)

Name: Stun
Effect: Cannot take any actions: no cards, movement, basic attack or block, Sidestep, Flash Cut, gauntlet skills, Brain draws or peeks, or gear swaps. Only the Wait button works; reactions that fire automatically still fire.
Stacking & Re-apply: Not stackable: re-applying keeps the longer timer
Sources: Giant Beaver 'Chomp' (3t); Cerberus 'Venom Tail' (15t, also knocks 3 cards from hand); Inflamed Minotaur 'Bull Rush' (5t, chance = spaces x4%); Weregoat Charge landing (3t); self: Stone Encase [Strap of Stone] (5t), Cryonics (15t on the iced ally or self)
Notes: Point to Prove (Cory) can pay HP to shrug it off.

Name: Disarm
Effect: Cannot play attack cards or use the auto-attack button.
Stacking & Re-apply: Stackable: re-applying ADDS the new duration
Sources: Pipe Crawler 'Claw' (25% chance, 5t); self: Shield of Growth (10t), Succumb phase 2 (10t)
Notes: Point to Prove (Cory) can pay HP to shrug it off.

Name: Silence
Effect: Cannot play spell cards.
Stacking & Re-apply: Stackable: re-applying ADDS the new duration
Sources: None in the live game
Notes: Point to Prove covers it, but no enemy or card applies it to the player.

Name: Burn
Effect: Each cycle take burn damage that doubles (1, 2, 4, 8...). Each stack is one cycle of burning. Attacking while burning also deals the current burn damage to you.
Expiry Model: Stacks (one burns per cycle; never expires by the clock)
Stacking & Re-apply: Stackable: re-applying adds stacks; the doubling counter resets only when Burn is gone
Sources: Fire Goblin Mage 'Ember' (1); Fire Mage 'Fire Bolt' (2); Inflamed Minotaur 'Attack' (2); Ifrit 'Fire Breath' 5x5 (5); fire tiles stepped on: Fire Goblin Shaman 'Fire Wall' (3), Ifrit breath tiles (5), Minotaur wake and Bull Rush lane (2, heals him 10); self: Wand of the Phoenix Feather backlash (1 per burn-applying play)

Name: Poison
Effect: Take X damage at the start of each cycle, then lose 1 poison. Under Elixir a tick heals instead.
Expiry Model: Value decays 1 per cycle; also expires when its timer ends
Stacking & Re-apply: Stackable: re-applying adds the value and keeps the longer timer
Sources: White Manticore 'Stinger' (8); Sewer Cobra Venom Spray (8, cone) and its poison-back (3)

Name: Cursed
Effect: Deal 20% less damage and take 20% of the damage you deal as self-damage.
Stacking & Re-apply: Not stackable: re-applying keeps the longer timer
Sources: None in the live game (exists only in the player/enemy mirror maps used by Expel Negativity)

Name: Frozen
Effect: Cannot play cards (movement still allowed).
Stacking & Re-apply: Not stackable: re-applying keeps the longer timer
Sources: Automatic when Cold reaches 5 stacks (in practice the Ice Troll)

Name: Cuffed
Effect: Cannot draw cards.
Stacking & Re-apply: Not stackable: re-applying keeps the longer timer
Sources: Cerberus Venom Tail aftermath when the stun ends (10t); self: Succumb (10t); Demon Cuff (15t); Mind Eater Manipulate Mind Space (15t)

Name: Shocked
Effect: Arc X damage to nearby allies at the start of each cycle, then lose 1 stack.
Expiry Model: Value decays 1 per cycle; also expires when its timer ends
Stacking & Re-apply: Stackable: re-applying adds the value and keeps the longer timer
Sources: Spark Mage 'Spark' (1 stack, 15t)

Name: Slowed
Effect: Movement costs 3 tempo per tile instead of 1 while any stack remains. Each stack lasts 5 tempo; tiles moved do not consume stacks. The clock-timed variant (Approach, Snow Wraith, Fire Web) lasts N tempo instead.
Expiry Model: Stacks, 5 tempo each (own clock), or Timed (tempo)
Stacking & Re-apply: Stackable: re-applying adds stacks. A timer over stacks makes it timed for at least that long; stacks over a timer are ignored
Sources: Ice Mage 'Frost Bolt' (1); Spiked Web trap in cave interiors (2, plus 5 damage); Snow Wraith (timed 3t); Magma Spider Fire Web (while inside); self: Petey the Pet Rock while in hand (held at 2), Approach (timed, 10t)

Name: Staggered
Effect: Attack cards cost 15 more mana while any stack remains; each stack lasts 5 tempo (attack cards do not consume stacks). The clock-timed variant (Tower Shield) lasts N tempo instead.
Expiry Model: Stacks, 5 tempo each (own clock), or Timed (tempo)
Stacking & Re-apply: Stackable: re-applying adds stacks (timed/stack merge as Slowed)
Sources: Self only: Tower Shield (timed, 40t)

Name: Drain
Effect: Lose 10 mana at the start of each cycle, then lose 1 stack. Hitting 0 mana breaks all maintained cards.
Expiry Model: Value decays 1 per cycle; also expires when its timer ends
Stacking & Re-apply: Stackable: re-applying adds the value and keeps the longer timer
Sources: Self only: Succumb (1, 10t); Release Soul held in hand (held at 1 stack)

Name: Weighted
Effect: Card plays cost 2 more tempo (hand, Quiver and Manifest plays); each card played burns a stack. The basic attack and basic block are not cards and are not taxed.
Sources: Infected Hunter Net Throw (1 stack per card in hand)

Name: Hexed
Effect: One card in your hand costs +X mana until it is played. A hex belongs to its card: it leaves with the card if the card leaves the hand any other way. Each hex is its own instance on its own card.
Expiry Model: Timed (tempo) or until the card is played
Stacking & Re-apply: Never merges: each application hexes another card (stacks on one card only when there are more hexes than cards)
Sources: Necromancer 'Dark Bolt' (2 hexes, +30 mana each, 25t); Mind Eater Mind Slow (+20 on every card in hand, until played)

Name: Locked
Effect: One card in hand cannot be played. A lock belongs to its card and leaves with it. Each Locked is its own instance on its own card, so several cards can be locked at once.
Stacking & Re-apply: Never merges: each application locks another card
Sources: None in the live game (deck_manager reads it, nothing creates it)

Name: Rooted
Effect: Cannot move (cards can still be played).
Stacking & Re-apply: Stackable: re-applying ADDS the new duration
Sources: Treant 'Root' (8t, range 4)

Name: Clumsy
Effect: 30% chance to discard a random card whenever you play a card, while any stack remains; each stack lasts 5 tempo (card plays do not consume stacks).
Sources: White Manticore 'Stinger' (3 stacks = 15 tempo)

Name: Vulnerable
Effect: Take 30% more damage while any stack remains. Each stack lasts 5 tempo: 1 stack dissipates every 5 tempo on the debuff's own clock. Hits do not consume stacks.
Sources: Giant Beaver 'Tail Whip' (5); Large Bear 'Roar' (1 to every player unit within 4); Cerberus venom aftermath (2); Inflamed Minotaur Bull Rush (1 to the victim and to everything trampled); self: Bloodlust (3)

Name: Brittle
Effect: Armor decays an extra 2 per cycle while any stack remains. Each stack lasts 5 tempo: 1 stack dissipates every 5 tempo on the debuff's own clock.
Sources: Ice Troll, every hit incl. 'Club' and 'Clobber' (1)

Name: Cold
Effect: Stacking. At 5 (summed value) you become Frozen for 5 tempo and Cold clears.
Expiry Model: Stacks (value) and also expires when its timer ends
Stacking & Re-apply: Stackable: re-applying adds the value and keeps the longer timer
Sources: Ice Troll, every hit (1, 5t); if a hit freezes you, 'Clobber' (50 damage) follows; Snow Wraith Snowball (2, 5t)

Name: Blind
Effect: 80% chance for your attacks to miss (BLIND_MISS): attack cards, the basic attack and Flash Cut. Each stack lasts 5 tempo.
Sources: Giant Hawk 'Swoop' (20% chance, 1 stack)
Notes: The miss mechanic lives on PlayerStats.is_blinded; the Debuff is the badge.

Name: Weakened
Effect: Deal 30% less damage while any stack remains; each stack lasts 5 tempo. Attacks do not consume stacks.
Sources: Inflamed Minotaur Bull Rush, on the same roll as its stun (1 stack); Roc Eye Scrape (2 stacks)

Name: Lost in the Labyrinth
Effect: Your hand is scrambled and must be played left to right (only the first card in line is playable). You cannot draw by any means.
Stacking & Re-apply: Not stackable: re-applying keeps the longer timer
Sources: The Labyrinth boss room (Inflamed Minotaur): every 25 tempo, on every player
Notes: Lifts the moment the Minotaur dies.

Name: Marvolo's Misunderstanding
Effect: Take 25 damage when this expires naturally. Purging it first (Cleanse, Fresh Start, etc.) prevents the damage.
Expiry Model: Timed (tempo), pays out on natural expiry
Stacking & Re-apply: Not stackable: re-applying keeps the longer timer
Sources: Marvolo Gaunt ring, right after it saves you from death
Notes: Bespoke GENERIC debuff; keeps its own name and description.

Name: Regen Frozen
Effect: Mana regeneration is paused.
Default Magnitude / Duration: the tempo spent on the gear swap
Sources: Swapping gear mid-combat
Notes: Flag only; no badge.

Name: Inebriate
Effect: Retired. No behaviour.
Sources: Nothing applies it
Notes: Enum slot kept only for save-order compatibility.

Name: Tethered
Effect: Retired. No behaviour.
Sources: Nothing applies it
Notes: Enum slot kept only for save-order compatibility.

Name: Magnetized
Effect: Retired. No behaviour.
Sources: Nothing applies it
Notes: Enum slot kept only for save-order compatibility.

Name: Linked
Effect: Retired. No behaviour.
Sources: Nothing applies it
Notes: Enum slot kept only for save-order compatibility.

Name: Stun (enemy)
Effect: Cannot act at all; every action clock resets, so its next action is delayed by the full stun.
Stacking & Re-apply: Not stackable: keeps the longer timer
Sources: What's the Worst? (50%, 5t); Escape and Bewilder [Houdinis Slippers] (3t, all within 3); Vengeful Shield (5t, nearest melee enemy); Element Pollination [Elemental Weaver]: 5 Shock becomes a 5t stun

Name: Slow (enemy)
Effect: Each movement action costs +2 tempo while any stack remains; each stack lasts 5 tempo on its own clock (moves do not consume stacks). Each stack also shortens the Inflamed Minotaur's Labyrinth Leap by 1.
Sources: Sword of Theseus on-self (2; 3 at Lv3); Earth Rattle [Bessy] (2, radius 3)
Notes: Tooltip says '3 tempo per tile'; the code charges per movement action.

Name: Disarm (enemy)
Effect: Cannot attack.
Stacking & Re-apply: Stackable: re-applying ADDS the new duration
Sources: Roll (5t on the enemy hit); Sweeping Disarm (5t, melee AoE)
Notes: Because of the overwrite, Wither's +1 shortens an existing Disarm (see Open Design Notes).

Name: Disarmed (attacks)
Effect: Each stack adds 5 tempo of Disarm (the enemy cannot attack).
Sources: Switch Kick (1); Song of a Swords Sing [Sword Breaker] (1); Spidey Web Shooters on-self (1)

Name: Marked
Effect: Your attacks deal +15% damage to it (MARKED_BONUS_PERCENT).
Stacking & Re-apply: Not stackable: re-applying keeps the longer timer (the +1 riders never shorten it)
Sources: Mark card (25t)

Name: Silenced (enemy)
Effect: Cannot cast spells or ranged special attacks; any queued spell is dropped.
Stacking & Re-apply: Not stackable: keeps the longer timer
Sources: Choke (5t); Circe's Wand of Cauldron Stirring (5t per damaging attack)

Name: Choke
Effect: Takes choke damage (half the caster's auto-attack damage) at the end of each cycle; loses 1 stack per cycle.
Sources: Choke card

Name: Burn (enemy)
Effect: Takes doubling damage each cycle (1, 2, 4, 8...); one stack burns per cycle. Under Element Pollination the burn splashes enemies within 2.5 tiles.
Expiry Model: Stacks (one per cycle; never expires by the clock)
Sphere Grid Amp: Burn Amp (flat extra hit after each tick)
Sources: Fire Book (1 per hit); Fire Quiver on-self (1); Equator on-self (4); Fireball (3, AoE); Gift from the Phoenix (5, nearest enemy); Harnessed Sun ring (+2 whenever burn is applied)

Name: Cold (enemy)
Effect: Stacking; at 5 it becomes Frozen for 5 tempo and Cold resets. Thaws 3 stacks per cycle. Under Element Pollination each tick also deals doubling damage.
Sources: Frost Book (1); Ice Orb (2); Frost Quiver on-self (1); Ice Grenade [Belt of Scrolls] (2, radius 2); passive effect 'freeze_enemy' (5)

Name: Frozen (enemy)
Effect: Cannot act at all; action clocks reset.
Sources: Automatic at 5 Cold

Name: Poison (enemy)
Effect: Takes damage equal to its stacks each cycle, then loses 1 stack.
Sphere Grid Amp: Poison Amp (stacks% chance of a bonus hit each tick)
Sources: Hemotoxins [Alchemeist belt] (10; 20 below 50% HP); Poison Bomb [Potion Belt] (6, radius 2); Mad Scientist Utility->Poison (2-9); Blood Hunter constellation (4, 15% on attack); sphere 'apply bleed' passive (lands as poison)
Notes: Pop Rocks (Cory) bursts when poison is re-applied.

Name: Shock (enemy)
Effect: Takes damage equal to its stacks each cycle, deals damage equal to stack to a nearby enemy (2 squares away), then loses 1 stack. Under Element Pollination 5 stacks become a 5-tempo stun.
Sources: Car Battery (3, slotted cards); Shock Quiver on-self (2); Reaction Rod (4 to a melee attacker); Kinetic Armor passive (1 per Defense card in deck)
Notes: Tooltip says it arcs to nearby enemies; the code only damages the shocked enemy. God of Thunder and Grounding absorb shock stacks.

Name: Bleed (enemy)
Effect: Takes 1 damage per tile moved; each damage removes a stack.
Sources: Splinter [Wooden Sword] (1); Horned Nasal Helm on-self (1); Wooden Spear on-self (1); Sabre Tooth on-self (5, +5 on a repeat target); Wooden Shield (1 to a melee attacker); Gauntlets of Dungeon Mastering wolves (1 + pack size per bite)

Name: Vulnerable (enemy)
Effect: Your hits deal +30% while any stack remains; each stack lasts 5 tempo on its own clock (hits do not consume stacks).
Sources: M for Mini [Belt of Wumbology] (2); Stance Switch [Mits of Chingiz] (2); Golden arrow [Cupids Bow] (2); Assasian Belt on-self (1); Reaper Scythe (1 per hit); Mauls Sabre blue-after-red (1); Crooked Dueling Shield red slot (1) and crit on a Weakened target (2)

Name: Weaken (enemy)
Effect: Deals 30% less damage while any stack remains; each stack lasts 5 tempo on its own clock (attacks do not consume stacks). Zone variant (Territorial Mark): no stacks, lasts while it stands in the smoke.
Expiry Model: Stacks, 5 tempo each (own clock), or zone
Sources: M for Mini (2); Cinquedea card and manifest [Slotted Rope Half Sleeve] (1); Improvised Ammo [Wrist Rocket] (3); Lead arrow [Cupids Bow] (2); Earth Rattle (2); Fan Save [Fanned Bracers] (1); Slotted Sash (1 to a random enemy within 5); Mauls Sabre blue slot (1); Crooked Dueling Shield blue slot (1), crit (1), full block (2); Territorial Mark [Bow of Arash] zone (25t corridor)

Name: Tripped
Effect: Move actions cover 4 fewer tiles (TRIP_MOVE_PENALTY); no step if that leaves none.
Expiry Model: Timed (tempo); wears off on its own
Sources: Trip card (10t)
Notes: Enemy-only; the keyword legend lists it but the player has no Tripped debuff.

Name: Rooted (enemy)
Effect: Cannot move; can still attack and cast.
Stacking & Re-apply: Stackable: re-applying ADDS the new duration
Sources: Vines (15t); Gravity Gauntlets on-self (5t); Spiked Web trap (25t to an enemy that steps in)

Name: Cursed (enemy)
Effect: Deals 20% less damage and takes 20% of the damage it deals as self-damage.
Stacking & Re-apply: Stackable: re-applying ADDS the new duration
Sphere Grid Amp: Curse Amp (+% less damage), Curse Pain (+% self-damage)
Sources: No direct source; arrives only via Expel Negativity, Misery Loves Company or Territorial Death

Name: Narashimha
Effect: Cannot heal above the health it had when the debuff landed.
Stacking & Re-apply: Keeps the longer timer; the cap only ever lowers
Sources: Neither Man nor Beast [Mane of Narashimha] (10t)

Name: Polymorph
Effect: A pig: can only walk and make basic melee attacks. Re-decides its queued action.
Sources: Polymorph [Circe's Wand] (5t, fires when a 5th distinct debuff lands)

Name: Taunt
Effect: Must attack whoever taunted it.
Stacking & Re-apply: Re-applying overwrites the target and timer
Sources: Taunt card (10t, AoE); Golden arrow [Cupids Bow] (50%, 5t); Tricks of Alberich [Ring of Nibelung] (5t, radius 4); Girdle of Aphrodite on-self (15t)

Name: Fear
Effect: Moves away from the source of its fear while it lasts.
Stacking & Re-apply: Re-applying overwrites the source and timer
Sources: Lead arrow [Cupids Bow] (50%, 5t)

Name: Cupid Mark
Effect: Struck by a Cupid arrow (Golden or Lead). Carrying both marks turns it into a Tree.
Sources: Cupids Bow golden and lead arrows

Name: Tree
Effect: Turned into a tree: cannot act, keeps every buff and debuff, regrows 3 health on each of its first 3 tempo.
Sources: Both Cupid marks landing

Name: Exposed
Effect: Its armor was broken through to 0. Fires on-expose passives (Easy Target, Premeditated) and reactions.
Expiry Model: Flag until it gains armor again (cleared on any armor gain)
Sources: Any hit that breaks the last of its armor; Armor Break doubles damage to armor
Notes: The player side has no Exposed badge; an armor-breaking hit only fires on_exposed reactions and Reverberate Regrowth.

Name: Wear Down (enemy)
Effect: Its attacks deal X less damage; X grows by 1 with each of your attacks while your Wear Down buff is active.
Stacking & Re-apply: Keeps the longer timer; the reduction stacks
Sources: Attacks made under the Wear Down buff (Brad)

Name: Lowered Physical Defense
Effect: Physical hits land X% harder on it. Applied as groups of stacks; each stack lasts 5 tempo on its group's own clock.
Stacking & Re-apply: A stronger % overrides a weaker % while both groups have stacks. For instance, 4 stacks at 10% plus an ally's 2 stacks at 50%: the 50% applies until its 2 stacks are out, then the remaining 10% stacks apply.
Sources: Mad Scientist Defense->Poison (Ryan)
Notes: No badge on the enemy.

Name: Serial Killer Blindness
Effect: The enemy cannot see or act against that player until the player attacks it; the ambush attack auto-crits.
Sources: Serial Killer passive (Cory): when an enemy first drops to 11-25% HP
Notes: Flag only; no badge. Shown on the player as Enlightened 100% when the ambush is armed.

Name: Global debuff riders
Effect: Laced Arrow (Stephen) adds +1 Burn/Cold/Shock; Wither (Cory) adds +1 to any debuff; Territorial Death re-applies an existing one; Expel Negativity moves one of your debuffs onto the nearest enemy; Misery Loves Company spreads the highest values on an AoE; Feral Evocation swaps burn/cold/shock/poison to the slot's element.
Sphere Grid Amp: Stun / Bleed / Burn / Shock / Slow / Root / Disarm / Silence / Vuln / Weaken Amp nodes strengthen debuffs but never apply one
Sources: Laced Arrow, Wither, Territorial Death, Expel Negativity, Misery Loves Company, Feral Evocation
Notes: Reference row: these touch any debuff, so they are not repeated per effect.
